exceptions.reason: Next.js 14.2.35 contains known advisories affecting image optimization and App Router cache handling. Upgrading to Next.js 15 requires breaking migration across async request headers, React 19, and Better Auth adapter.
exceptions.exploitability: Low in RESOLVE-ONE architecture: remote image optimization is restricted to trusted origins, App Router routes enforce Cache-Control: no-store, and server actions are not used for privileged mutations (Convex is used directly).
compensatingControls: Reverse proxy / Next.js config enforces no-store cache directives on authenticated routes
Strict Content-Security-Policy with nonce-based strict-dynamic and isolated frame-ancestors
Input schemas strictly bound by Zod before processing

exceptions.reason: Zod < 4.6.6 memory exhaustion when validating unbounded collection constraints. Fix requires Zod 4.x which introduces breaking API changes across existing schemas.
exceptions.exploitability: Low in RESOLVE-ONE: all HTTP request bodies are hard-capped at 1MB by Next.js / Edge runtime, preventing transmission of massive collections before Zod validation executes.
compensatingControls: JSON payload size restricted to 1MB at server gateway
Array fields in schemas have explicit small lengths (e.g. tags: max 10)
Distributed rate limiter throttles incoming requests per IP/account

exceptions.reason: DOMPurify is pulled as a transitive dependency of jspdf for SVG rendering. Resolving requires upstream jspdf release.
exceptions.exploitability: Zero in RESOLVE-ONE: the application does not invoke jspdf.html() or render untrusted HTML/SVG strings into PDFs. PDF generation uses explicit programmatic text layout API only.
compensatingControls: PDF generator does not invoke DOMPurify or jspdf.html()
Evidence files are stored as client-side encrypted blobs and never rendered as DOM trees

exceptions.reason: Flagged transitively via bundled dompurify. Upgrading requires jspdf v4 major rewrite.
exceptions.exploitability: Zero in RESOLVE-ONE: only programmatic text layout is used, no untrusted HTML/SVG inputs.
compensatingControls: No HTML/DOM parsing invoked in PDF export
Strict input validation on dispute export strings

exceptions.reason: Transitive build-time tool of Next.js CSS compilation pipeline.
exceptions.exploitability: Zero in production runtime: executed strictly during npm run build on trusted static CSS stylesheets.
compensatingControls: Build-time only CSS processing; no dynamic user CSS compilation allowed

exceptions.reason: Vitest < 3.2.6 UI server arbitrary file read advisory. Upgrading to Vitest 5 requires Vite 6 major upgrade.
exceptions.exploitability: Zero in production: Vitest is a devDependency never bundled into production build. In CI, Vitest runs in headless batch mode (`vitest run`) without launching the vulnerable UI server socket.
compensatingControls: Vitest excluded from production bundle and Vercel deployments
CI executes headless runner `vitest run` exclusively
No UI server ports are bound or exposed

exceptions.reason: Tinypool transitive dependency of vitest worker pool. Upstream upgrade linked to vitest major.
exceptions.exploitability: Zero in production: Dev dependency only, not included in production runtime.

exceptions.reason: Vite dev server alternate path file access advisory. Dev dependency only.
exceptions.exploitability: Zero in production: RESOLVE-ONE uses Next.js runtime; Vite is only used as Vitest test runner.
compensatingControls: Vite dev server is never started; only Vitest test runner executes
